memory_update.text: WMT should remain a reference anchor for the node, not an alpha-hunt candidate, because its private-brand actions define the retailer-power demand signal.

THS is a direct underfollowed private-label manufacturing candidate for the retail shelf-access/private-label node; next layer must verify customer concentration, margin resilience, and private-brand volume growth.

SPSC maps to the less obvious retail-data/replenishment-system chokepoint rather than to private-label manufacturing; survival in later layers depends on evidence of retailer-mandated workflows and durable supplier switching costs.
ADV is a speculative small-cap service-layer candidate because Daymon/private-brand capabilities may be embedded inside a broader, messier retail-services business.

Need a later pass for packaging, testing/certification, and category-data vendors tied to private-label programs; many relevant assets may be private, acquired, or buried inside diversified public companies.

node: Retail shelf access, private-label displacement and category control
summary: Expanded the universe for the retail shelf-access/private-label node using a two-lane funnel. Walmart is kept only as a reference anchor because its private-brand actions define the demand signal and retailer bargaining power. The underfollowed lane highlights public companies one or two steps away from the obvious consumer-brand battle: private-label manufacturing, retail EDI/replenishment infrastructure, and private-brand/category execution services. These are research candidates, not recommendations.
